newsitem.title: DENMARK: Unidanmark forms pact with Swedish post.
newsitem.headline: Unidanmark forms pact with Swedish post.

text.p: Denmark's Unidanmark on Thursday said it had signed an agreement with Svenska Postgirot giving the Danish banking group outlets through more 1,OOO post office branches in Sweden.
Unidanmark said that the deal would mean it could offer a full range of its financial products in Sweden, where over 90 percent of all companies had postgiro accounts.

"In reality the deal gives our bank a nationwide distribution net in Sweden enabling our customers to have access to Unidanmark services through more than 1,000 post offices all over Sweden," Unidanmark's Stockholm manager Michael Rasmussen said in a statement.
"The arrangement is aimed primarily at strengthening Unidanmark's business potential in the Swedish market and supplementing its product range there," he said.
Unidanmark, Denmark's second biggest bank, opened in Stockholm on July 1, 1996 as a first step in its strategy to expand activities in the Nordic region.
In Denmark, BG Bank, the country's third biggest bank and a major rival of Unidanmark, uses post offices as outlets for its services. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
